poset_unavoidable.note: Exact X228 helper: exists d before all finite posets, ~ poset_dimension_at_most P d -> minor (poset_cover_graph P) H, host before pattern, GTBase.posets and upstream minor unchanged; d = 0 and empty posets allowed. Not tournament unavoidability.

tournament_unavoidable.note: Exact unvd.unavoidable: every bundled tournament with exactly N vertices contains an arbitrary finite digraph D through an injective map preserving arcs one way (upstream is_dhom on to_GT); tournament_unavoidable_unbundledE proves it equivalent to the unbundled irreflexive, semicomplete and asymmetric reading via the same-carrier factory. Not induced; loops and digons are allowed in D and then never contained.

unavoidability_number.note: Exact unvd.unvd: N-unavoidable and not M-unavoidable for EVERY smaller natural M. The empty digraph has value 0, values are unique and at least #|D|; no existence or positivity guard.

linearly_unavoidable.note: Exact X221.x221_linearly_unavoidable: one natural C before all digraphs and values, F D -> unavoidability_number D N -> N <= C * #|D|; members without a value impose no bound.
